name: Langley
blurb: Our shop is in Langley on 40th Ave, so Langley calls usually get the shortest response time we offer. Walnut Grove, Willoughby, Brookswood, Murrayville and Fort Langley are all a short drive.

name: Surrey
blurb: Surrey is our busiest service area outside Langley. Cloverdale, Fleetwood, Guildford, Newton and South Surrey are all regular same-day territory.

name: Abbotsford
blurb: Abbotsford is the eastern edge of our regular route, and we are out that way most weeks. Emergency calls east of Aldergrove are still answered 24/7.

name: Maple Ridge
blurb: We cover Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows, including Albion, Silver Valley and Hammond. The older wood doors common in the area are a specialty of ours.

name: Coquitlam
blurb: Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam and Port Moody are all inside our regular service area, from Burke Mountain down to the Mary Hill bypass.

name: Burnaby
blurb: We service all of Burnaby, from Metrotown and Burnaby Heights to Brentwood and the Lougheed corridor, in both houses and townhome complexes.

name: New Westminster
blurb: New Westminster's older housing stock means a lot of original hardware still in service. We repair rather than replace wherever the door allows it.

name: Richmond
blurb: Richmond's damp, salt-air conditions are hard on cables, springs and bottom seals. We carry the parts for all three on the truck.

name: Delta
blurb: North Delta, Ladner and Tsawwassen are all covered. Coastal exposure in Tsawwassen makes annual maintenance especially worthwhile.

name: Vancouver
blurb: We serve Vancouver proper, including the lane-access garages common on the east side, where tight clearances and older track are the norm.

name: North Vancouver
blurb: North Vancouver's steep driveways and heavy winter rain are hard on door balance and weather seals. We are up there regularly.

name: West Vancouver
blurb: West Vancouver marks the western end of our service area, from Ambleside through to Horseshoe Bay.

name: Port Coquitlam
blurb: Port Coquitlam sits right between our Coquitlam and Pitt Meadows runs, so Citadel Heights, Mary Hill, Riverwood and the downtown core are all regular stops. Broken springs and off-track doors usually get a same-day visit.

name: Pitt Meadows
blurb: Pitt Meadows is a quick trip over the Golden Ears Bridge from our Langley shop. We cover Osprey Village, South Bonson, the Highland Park area and the farm properties out toward the dikes.

name: Mission
blurb: We serve Mission from the Abbotsford side, including Cedar Valley, Hatzic, Silverdale and the homes above the Lougheed. Call ahead for emergencies and we will give you an honest arrival time.
